name: m27-27.4-understand-linux
title: Lab 27.4, part 1: get the lab, see what each file is, the fake data, look before you run, the setup check, then each isolation and egress idea on its own: this terminal as a process on a kernel in a virtual machine, a real container (same kernel, own processes, no network, read-only files, a process limit), one sandbox config and one network config read line by line, names against the DNS allow-list, two recorded requests layer by layer, and one replay read line by line

steps.label: Same kernel
steps.type: uname -r && sudo docker run --rm alpine:3.20 uname -r

steps.label: No network
steps.type: sudo docker run --rm --network none alpine:3.20 wget -q -T 3 -O- http://example.com

steps.label: Process limit
steps.type: sudo docker run --rm --pids-limit 4 alpine:3.20 sh -c 'for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do sleep 2 & done; wait'

steps.label: Request draft
steps.type: python3 explore.py request U1 first-draft | tail -n 5
